description: This file contains the class definition for 'Subscription' within the Opencart admin controller for sale. It handles listing, filtering, and viewing subscription data, including generating URLs with filter parameters, and rendering the subscription list view.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale subscriptions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to initialize the subscription list page, handle filters, and render the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the subscription list view output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of subscriptions based on current filters and pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including related order, customer, and subscription plan details.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updates to a subscription, such as changing the subscription plan, and returns success or error in JSON format.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a subscription, including status changes and comments.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a particular subscription, with pagination.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history comment or status change for a subscription.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Retrieves order details related to a subscription and renders the order information view.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order associated with a subscription as a JSON string.
